title_en: OPPORTUNITY! 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE AT LION RESIDENCE 2!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in one of the most elite facilities in Tirana! Organization: Living room and kitchen Bedroom Toilets Balcony Regular cubature. Post parking available for a fee. The newest and most prestigious project in Tirana Lion Residence 2 is located in a strategic position only 1 km from the center of Tirana, near the Black Bird and with direct access to the street of Tirana Curated with the most innovative materials and construction methods, it is characterized by a variety of greenery and natural light through the glass facade.
